items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: Hose would always let me have the car... Slim lived out there in Tibeto with Hose.

ctx.x: Yeah he believed in the Bible and he could recite the 23rd Psalms. And man he said like this and he told me he said, Mr. Cotton you and your wife y'all gonna outlive me. You gonna outlive me. You want my car? Because you know he couldn't trust everybody with their cars you know. I was always trust with it. He would let me have the car. Hose would always let me have the car. Anytime they got brought a brand new car I would be the first one to drive it. And I'd go pick the guys up in the city to bring them back to…
Mitch Cotton can I borrow 50 dollars? She'd say yeah Slim sure.
